original_test_intent: Confirm the active VBIOS version of every NVIDIA GPU matches its approved board/SKU firmware manifest.
original_method: Inventory GPU UUID/BDF/serial/board SKU and driver/tool version; run the exact vbios_version CSV query read-only; join each result to the approved per-board manifest; compare count and version strings; preserve raw output/errors and do not flash or reset on mismatch.
manual_activity: Firmware owner approves the board/SKU-to-VBIOS manifest and final verdict; inventory collection and exact comparison are automated.
safety_requirements: Reject embedded credentials and host-key bypass
Preserve unavailable/error values and do not auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Compare every device to approved manifest

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a per-board expected-versus-observed VBIOS table keyed by stable GPU identity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Avoids assuming every fitted board necessarily carries the same VBIOS.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: nvidia-smi reports active firmware strings but does not by itself prove staged-bank content.

project_override_considerations: Mixed board revisions may have different approved VBIOS strings; the manifest, not row order, governs acceptance.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, command and Criteria consistently target VBIOS version.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is available; expected firmware is a project verdict input.

review_improvement: Binds each reported VBIOS to the correct physical board and forbids an inventory mismatch from triggering an uncontrolled flash.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware acceptance is board-specific: identical GPU names can contain different board revisions. UUID/BDF/serial correlation makes each literal VBIOS string attributable while preserving this case as read-only inventory.
